description: Delete a single category or category group. By default fails (HTTP 422) if dependencies exist, returning a structured `dependents` payload. Set force=true to delete and disassociate from all related budgets, transactions, recurring items, etc. Force delete is irreversible.

category_id.description: Id of the category or category group to delete.

force.description: If true, force deletion even if dependencies exist (irreversible).

name: delete_category
